$description: Polychrome base tokens: inscriptional display type, a serif with polytonic Greek for reading, and squarer, stone-cut corners. Applied on top of base.tokens.json. The fonts are not bundled: load Cinzel and Gentium Book Plus (both SIL OFL) yourself, or the stacks fall back to system serifs.

display.$description: Display headings, set like a carved inscription.

serif.$description: Reading text and quotations, with full polytonic Greek.
